title: Clinical Text, Literature & Terminologies
blurb: Clinical notes corpora, biomedical QA benchmarks, the literature itself and the standard vocabularies that tie data together.

items.name: n2c2 / i2b2 NLP Datasets
items.description: Annotated de-identified clinical notes from the i2b2/n2c2 shared tasks: de-identification, medication extraction, temporal relations, obesity, smoking status, emrQA and more.
items.access_note: Free; register on the DBMI Data Portal and sign the DUA.

items.name: MedNLI
items.description: 14,049 clinician-annotated natural language inference pairs built from MIMIC-III notes.

items.name: PubMed Baseline
items.description: Annual XML baseline plus daily updates of 37 million+ biomedical citations and abstracts — the raw material for literature mining and biomedical language models.

items.name: PMC Open Access Subset
items.description: Millions of full-text journal articles from PubMed Central licensed for reuse and text mining, in XML and plain text.
items.access_note: Open bulk download (licence varies per article: commercial vs non-commercial subsets).

items.name: CORD-19
items.description: COVID-19 Open Research Dataset: ~1 million scholarly articles on COVID-19 and coronaviruses with full text, released by AI2 (final release 2022).

paper.label: Wang LL et al. ACL NLP-COVID Workshop 2020

items.name: MedQA (USMLE)
items.description: Multiple-choice questions from US, Chinese and Taiwanese medical licensing exams — the most common benchmark for medical LLMs.

paper.label: Jin D et al. Appl Sci 2021;11:6421

items.name: MedMCQA
items.description: 194,000 multiple-choice questions from Indian AIIMS and NEET-PG entrance exams spanning 21 medical subjects with explanations.

items.name: PubMedQA
items.description: Biomedical research question-answering dataset (yes/no/maybe) built from PubMed abstracts, with 1,000 expert-labelled instances.

items.name: BioASQ
items.description: Annual challenge datasets for large-scale semantic indexing (MeSH) and biomedical question answering with expert-curated gold answers.
items.access_note: Free registration on the participants area.

items.name: MTSamples
items.description: ~5,000 sample transcribed medical reports across 40 specialties — handy for teaching clinical NLP without any data-use agreement.
items.access_note: Open web access (scraped versions on Kaggle).

items.name: UMLS Metathesaurus
items.description: Integrates 200+ biomedical vocabularies (SNOMED CT, ICD, MeSH, RxNorm, LOINC…) into concepts with cross-mappings, plus the Semantic Network and SPECIALIST lexicon.
items.access_note: Free UMLS Terminology Services licence (account approval required; some source vocabularies have extra terms).

items.name: ICD-11
items.description: WHO's current International Classification of Diseases with browser, coding tool and a free API for integration in health information systems.

items.name: LOINC
items.description: Universal code system for laboratory tests, clinical measurements and documents, required by many interoperability standards.

items.name: MeSH
items.description: NLM's controlled vocabulary thesaurus used to index PubMed, available as XML, RDF and via API.
